grammar.0.title: du or Sie?
grammar.0.text: du — friends, classmates, family, children. Sie — strangers, the office, doctors, teachers and older people. When in doubt, Sie is the safe choice. Sie is always written with a capital S (the polite form), and its verb form stays the same as the infinitive (-en) (exception: Sie sind).
grammar.1.note: Sie heißen — same as the infinitive: „Wie heißen Sie?“ And to a friend: „Wie heißt du?“
grammar.2.title: How to write an address
grammar.2.text: Hauptstraße 12 — street first, then the house number. Then the postcode (PLZ) and the city: 10115 Berlin — the code comes before the city name.
